arabic text: KAHWAY ZAINAB UJARI JANG KARBALA DI MUK GAYI\nLUTIYAAN GAYIYAAN RIDAWAAN.
english translation text: The devastated Zainab says: ‘The battle of Karbala\nhas ended, and our veils have been looted.’

arabic text:
KIWEIN SHAM LAY JAWAAN SAJJAD(AS) BEMAR AYE.
HOSH NAHI AOUNDI AYS NU AYE SAKHT LACHAR AYE.
MENU SAMAJ NAHI AOUNDI WERAN DISA MAIN KIWEIN
AYNU MAUT TU BACHAWAAN.
english translation text:
How can I take Sajjad to Shaam? He
is ill and barely conscious, utterly helpless. Brother,
I do not know which way to turn
or how to save him from death.

arabic text:
PA PA KHAK SIRAAN WICH AYS WAAL LOKAYE.
UMAT NE RASIYAAN DE SANU ZEWAR PAYE.
MAIN SUNYA AYE VERAN HAYE SHAM DE SHEHAR
DIYAAN BOO AOUKHIYAAN NE RAHWAAN.
english translation text:
People throw dust upon our heads. The nation
has adorned us with ropes as jewellery. Brother,
I have heard that the roads through
the city of Shaam are terribly difficult.

arabic text:
AOUNTH TU MAIN LATH PAYI AAN PAR RO NAHI SAKDI.
LASH UTAYE PATHRAAN DA HAI DHAIR HAAN TAKDI.
MERE HATH PABAND HIN KIWEIN LASH TU MAIN TERI
PATHRAAN NU AA HATAWAAN.
english translation text:
I have been pulled down from the camel, yet
I cannot even weep. I see a heap
of stones upon your body. My hands are
bound—how can I remove these stones from you?

arabic text:
SHAM SHEHAR WICH KIS NE SADAY PARDAY BANAONE.
MALOONA DE MAJMAY SADAY RAAH CHOON HATAONE.
MERA GHAZI(AS) VERAN JA NEHAR DE KINARE SAMIYAA
KATA KE BAHNWAAN.
english translation text:
Who will preserve our modesty in the city of
Shaam? Who will clear the crowds of the
accursed from our path? My Ghazi, my brother,
sleeps beside the river with both arms severed.

arabic text:
AKHTAR DUNYA FANI IK DIN MUK JANI.
RENI AYE DO JAG TE SYEDAAN DI KAHANI.
LAKH ROKE DUNYA PURSAY NU QAYAM RAKHNA
ZAHRA(SA) DIYAAN DUAWAAN
english translation text:
Akhtar, this world is temporary and will one day
end, but the story of the Sayyids will remain
in both worlds. Even if the world tries to
stop it, keep their mourning alive through Zahra’s prayers.
